categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the development, production, and sales of Class III implantable medical devices, focusing on neurosurgical cranial repair and fixation products, cardiothoracic surgical products, maxillofacial repair, and dental implant products. Its main revenue comes from neurosurgical PEEK and titanium material products, accounting for over 90% of its main business income. The company also develops products for skin filling and oral surgery, aiming for diversified business growth.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include proprietary processing techniques for titanium cranial repair and fixation products, design and manufacturing processes for PEEK bone plates, injection molding of PEEK materials, and recyclable laser sintering 3D printing technology for PEEK powder materials. The company has developed innovative 3D printed PEEK cranial repair systems and maintains advanced quality management systems compliant with ISO 13485 and Chinese medical device regulations.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company serves hospitals and medical institutions specializing in neurosurgery, cardiothoracic surgery, oral surgery, and maxillofacial repair. Key customers include top-tier hospitals across China and international markets such as the United States, Europe, Brazil, Russia, Australia, and Southeast Asia. The company’s products are used in clinical surgical procedures requiring implantable medical devices.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are primarily based in China with headquarters and manufacturing in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province. The company has subsidiaries and production facilities in the United States and Hong Kong, serving global markets including North America, Europe, Latin America, and Southeast Asia. Domestic sales dominate revenue, but overseas sales are growing steadily.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the medical device supply chain, focusing on product design, manufacturing, and distribution. It manages procurement of raw materials and components, some outsourced processing, and sells finished products through distributors and direct sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding PEEK material product penetration, developing innovative 3D printed implantable devices, and diversifying into cardiothoracic, oral, maxillofacial, and skin filling medical fields. R&D focuses on product innovation, cost-effective manufacturing processes, and obtaining regulatory approvals domestically and internationally. The company invests in biocompatible, bioresorbable materials and wireless intracranial pressure monitoring technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of implantable medical devices to hospitals and distributors. The company uses a buyout sales model with distributors responsible for market promotion and after-sales services. It also engages in direct sales in certain overseas markets, particularly the U.S.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading domestic market position in neurosurgical PEEK and titanium cranial repair products, with the largest market share in China. It competes by leveraging proprietary technologies, product innovation, and comprehensive clinical solutions. Competitors include other domestic and international medical device manufacturers specializing in high-value implantable devices.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2023, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 275 million, a 14.62% increase year-over-year, with net profit attributable to shareholders around RMB 75.5 million, stable compared to the prior year. The company maintains strong profitability with a net asset return of 13.46%. It has a workforce of 276 employees and continues to invest in R&D and production capacity expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes personalized, high-performance implantable medical devices with superior biocompatibility, aesthetics, and imaging compatibility, especially through its PEEK material products and 3D printing technology. It offers a comprehensive product portfolio covering multiple surgical needs, supported by strong clinical collaboration and quality management. Its innovation-driven approach and diversified product lines provide differentiated solutions that improve patient outcomes and meet evolving clinical demands.
